mapper.select: SELECT h.id, h.name, h.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, h.level, h.region, h.protection_unit AS protectionUnit, h.publish_time AS publishTime, h.description, h.history, h.cover_image AS coverImage, h.view_count AS viewCount, h.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM t_exhibit e WHERE e.heritage_id = h.id AND e.deleted_flag = 0) AS hasExhibit, h.create_time AS createTime FROM t_heritage h LEFT JOIN t_heritage_category c ON h.category_id = c.id WHERE h.id = #{id} AND h.deleted_flag = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE t_heritage SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_heritage SET favorite_count = favorite_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_heritage SET favorite_count = GREATEST(favorite_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
